口.m: Eating, speaking — and sounds: many 口 words are borrowed sounds (咖啡, 啦).

木.m: Trees and wooden things: 桌 table, 椅 chair.

亻.m: A person standing sideways — people and what they do.

氵.m: Three drops of water — rivers, liquids, washing.

扌.m: A hand — actions you do with your hands: 打 hit, 拿 take.

艹.m: Two blades of grass — plants, vegetables, tea.

讠.m: Short for 言 words — talking, language, asking.

土.m: Ground and places built on it.

女.m: Women, family and some feelings: 妈 mum, 好 good.

辶.m: A foot on the move — going, roads, distance.

日.m: Sunlight and time: 早 early, 晚 late.

阝.m: On the left it means a hill; on the right, a town.

宀.m: A roof — homes and what's inside them.

⺼.m: Looks like 月 but means meat — body parts: 脚 foot, 脸 face.

月.m: The moon — months and time (as a body part it is ⺼ flesh).

贝.m: Cowrie shells were money — buying, selling, cost.

囗.m: A wall all round — countries, gardens, surrounding.

广.m: A roof with one wall — shops, buildings.

忄.m: The heart written narrow — emotions: 忙 busy, 快 happy.

心.m: Thinking and feeling: 想 think, 忘 forget.

灬.m: Four dots of fire under the pot — cooking, heat.

钅.m: Short for 金 gold — metals and money.

车.m: A cart seen from above — cars, wheels, transport.

攵.m: A hand holding a stick — doing, teaching, changing.

刂.m: A knife on the right — cutting, dividing.

尸.m: A body lying down — also rooms and buildings.

禾.m: A grain stalk with a drooping head — crops, seasons, taxes.

米.m: Grains of rice scattered — rice and powder.

饣.m: Short for 食 eat — meals, drinks, hunger.

大.m: A person with arms stretched wide.

力.m: A muscled arm — effort and work.

子.m: A baby with arms out — children and small things.

门.m: A doorway — opening, asking at the door.

王.m: As a part on the left it is 玉 jade — precious things.

雨.m: Rain falling from a cloud — weather.

巾.m: A hanging cloth — towels, hats, curtains.

欠.m: An open mouth breathing out — singing, drinking, owing.

疒.m: A sick bed — diseases and pain.

皿.m: A bowl seen from the side — dishes and containers.

目.m: An eye on its side — looking, seeing.

穴.m: A hollow under a roof — holes, windows, empty.

⺮.m: Bamboo leaves on top — writing brushes, baskets, chopsticks.

酉.m: A jar for wine — alcohol, sauces, doctors.

寸.m: A hand with a pulse point — measuring, rules.

立.m: A person standing on the ground.

马.m: Often just a sound part: 妈 mā, 吗 ma, 码 mǎ.
